<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (appearing twice), and 127.80 (appearing twice). Counting each carbon represented by these peaks gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
